description: This PHP class 'FormatWithWorkStation' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide formatted string values based on a subunit ID. It retrieves a Subunit entity and returns its name, used in the context of the OrangeHRM system's maintenance access strategy for formatting values.

classes.name: FormatWithWorkStation
classes.description: A class that implements ValueFormatter to retrieve and format the name of a Subunit based on its ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the Subunit corresponding to the provided entity value ID, or null if the Subunit does not exist.
